public_fields.name: Pettenderly
public_fields.pitch: AI pet portraits from photos of your cat or dog
public_fields.details: Pettenderly turns photos of cats and dogs into downloadable AI portraits. Upload one to five photos of the same pet and choose a watercolor, royal or window-seat style. Review faces, coat markings and fine details before downloading. Each successful image uses one credit; failed generations do not consume credits. Paid credit packs and Pro subscriptions are available. Human-and-pet portraits and photo cleanup are beta features.
